service.heading: The service
service.body: {{appName}} is a community app that helps adults find, organise and join sports events. Events are organised by users; {{appName}} is not the organiser of, or a party to, any event.

eligibility.heading: Who can use it
eligibility.body: Only people aged 18 or over may use the app. The information you give must be accurate and your account must be used only by you.

conduct.heading: Conduct
conduct.body: Treat other users with respect. Harassment, threats, discrimination, fake accounts and fake events are not allowed. Accounts that break the rules may be restricted.

risk.heading: Sport and health
risk.body: Sport carries physical risk. You take part in events according to your own fitness and at your own responsibility. Event organisers are not required to be professional coaches.

content.heading: What you share
content.body: You are responsible for what you share in your profile and in events. Content that infringes other people's rights may be removed.

changes.heading: Changes
changes.body: These terms may change. For important changes we will ask you to accept the new version. The version you accept is recorded.

collected.heading: What data we collect
collected.body: Your email address, display name, optionally your city and district, the sports you play and your self-assessed level, and your consent records (which version you accepted and when). Precise location is not required.

purpose.heading: Why we use it
purpose.body: To manage your account, show you relevant events, keep the community safe and improve the service. Marketing messages are sent only if you give separate consent.

visibility.heading: Who can see it
visibility.body: Your profile is private by default. You choose whether to make it public; then your display name and sports are shown to other users. Your email address is never shown to other users.

security.heading: Security check
security.body: To prevent automated abuse we may use Cloudflare Turnstile during sign-up, sign-in and password reset. To tell people from automated software, it sends technical information from your device and browser (for example your IP address and browser characteristics) to Cloudflare. The legal basis for this and information on transfers abroad will be added to this text after legal review.

retention.heading: Retention and deletion
retention.body: We keep your data while your account is open. In Settings › Account you can download your data as a JSON file and request the deletion of your account. You can cancel a deletion request within 30 days; after that your login, profile, settings and sport profiles are deleted permanently. Records of which legal text you accepted and when may be kept without your name or email; their retention period will be added to this text after legal review.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: How to exercise your rights to access, correct and delete your personal data, and the identity of the data controller, will be added after legal review.
